items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or an image with its media, name, details, upload state and actions, for composers, threads and upload lists.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User images with fallbacks, size variants, status badges and overlapping groups.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A framed message bubble for chat text, short structured output, quoted replies, suggestions and reactions.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Buttons and inputs that sit together as one control, with the inner corners square and the borders joined.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick one day, several days or a range, with a keyboard grid, locale names and month and year navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides with buttons, arrow keys, indicators, drag and opt-in autoplay, on native scroll-snap; no carousel library.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Themeable SVG line, area, bar, pie, donut and radial charts with axes, a keyboard-navigable tooltip and legend, and a table for screen readers.

items.name: chart-scale
items.title: Chart scale
items.description: Pure functions for charts: scales, nice ticks, line, area and arc paths, pie angles, stacking and decimation.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked, unchecked and indeterminate.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code, terminal output, logs and diffs, with an optional header, line numbers, wrapping and a copy button.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input with a filtered list of options, with single or multiple (chips) selection.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette: a search field and a filtered, keyboard-navigable list of commands, inline or in a dialog.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Displays a menu to the user, such as a set of actions or functions, triggered by a right click or long press.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A data table over @shadow-js/table: sortable headers, pagination, column visibility and selection state.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date text field with a calendar in a popover; typed dates follow the locale and are checked against the limits.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window overlaid on the primary window, rendering the content underneath inert.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: A provider that sets the reading direction (left to right or right to left) for the components below it, and a hook that reads it.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet for mobile: drag the grip to snap it between heights or dismiss it, with the keyboard as well; it is a dialog.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Displays a menu to the user, such as a set of actions or functions, triggered by a button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty-state block: media, title, description and the next action.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field layout: a label, a control, a description and an error, wired to one control with the ids a form needs.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Accessible form wiring for any form library: a Form root, field ids, labels, descriptions, error messages and an error summary.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The inline SVG icons the components use (check, chevrons, close, search...). Replace with your icon library if you prefer.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A form input field.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A text control with addons (text, icons, buttons) on its sides, sharing one border and focus ring.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code with custom character patterns, digit normalization, paste, autofill and RTL keyboard navigation.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, content and actions, in a group, that can be a link.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: An inline note in a conversation: a status update, a system message, a bordered row or a labeled separator.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in a conversation: the avatar, the alignment, a header, the content and a footer of actions.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A chat transcript scroller that keeps the reader's place while a reply streams: anchored turns, following the newest text, history loading and a jump button.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled like an input, with its picker and keyboard support.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with flyout content, keyboard arrows between triggers, Escape to close and focus return.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field with a show and hide button, a strength meter slot and a Caps Lock hint, built on the PasswordToggleField primitive.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A compact or composable progress bar with a track, indicator, visible label and value.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A multi-step form of single-choice, multiple-choice, free-text and skippable questions, one at a time, with progress, validation and keyboard shortcuts.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of checkable buttons, known as radio buttons, where no more than one can be checked at a time.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels with draggable handles: pointer and keyboard resizing with bounds, an optional saved layout, and right-to-left support.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with thin custom scrollbars, a draggable thumb and keyboard scrolling.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from, triggered by a button.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable, collapsible sidebar that becomes a sheet on mobile, with menus, groups, tooltips and a Ctrl/Cmd+B shortcut.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An input where the user selects a value, or a range, from within a given range.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A responsive table component.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that are displayed one at a time.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast stores (useToast in components, createToaster in module code) and the Toaster that shows their notifications, after Sonner.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: A list of lines for the steps an agent takes: reasoning, tool calls, sources, plans and tasks, each with an icon, a title and a status, and optionally expandable.

items.name: ui-strings
items.title: UI strings
items.description: Translates the built-in words of the kit (Close, Next, Page n of m): a provider and a hook that read a pack such as the Arabic one.

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: useHighlightedCode
items.description: Syntax highlighting for code blocks with Shiki: a hook for the browser and an async function for the server, one element per line.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: A hook that tells whether the viewport is narrower than 768px. Used by the sidebar.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() helper: clsx plus tailwind-merge. Every component imports it.
